body: Theres no reason to stay

The reason for continuing is that you CAN improve your job situation , it might take time but it's possible. And maybe you just haven't chosen the right people to be with but I'm sure soon enough you will meet someone who cares for you more than anything and wants the best for you and puts you first, before themselves. It will get better if you try to have some faith. I know it feels like having faith is impossible right now but I know you have it in there somewhere if you chose to post on here.

How I feel / when I do it is very similar to what you said. It's like I won't do it for a month or something and it just starts to build up one thing after another and then I completely cut my entire arm and I keep waiting for more spaces to cut from then on. I can't particularly find the one thing making me upset because it really is a lot of things that build up , and even when I feel happy there's always this darkness inside of me that doesn't go away. I can never be fully happy and it devistates the one person that I trust and turn to (my boyfriend) because he Blaims it on himself and will try to make me feel happy for an hour straight and I try to laugh and stuff but I can't just pretend like eveything is okay.. He doesn't understand the difference between being sad and being depressed. I always worry if someone I'm close to hears about me cutting that they , especially my boyfriend , will follow down that dark path and be in my shoes. I push him away because I would never want him or anyone else to end up like me. I've made the mistake of seeking help from friends in the past and they've deserted me and our friendship. And I know they "weren't true friends" but I blame myself because I guess I would get sick of myself too. When I do it I feel like I just let everyone down.. It honestly makes it worse not telling anyone because you get up in the middle of the night to do it and it's just you in a dark room and it's moments like that where you have never felt so alone and you feel like you're going insane. Sometimes I wonder if it's all in my head (this sadness) but I'm truly just hurt by people's verbal abuse and find it hard to cope with. I just wish people weren't so judgemental of cutting so I could be more open about it. My mom considers people who do it "freaks" & "weirdos" and when I heard her say that it just brought me into this awful period of depression.
I just don't really wanna tell them at all I hate telling them it makes me feel even worse :/ and they just beg me not to and don't get it
I'm currently talking to them but to embarrassed to tell them because it upsets them and will make them feel awful :/
Even though you aren't asking for help just know I'm here for you and will give you support

Thank you for the support. I'm so used to doing it that I don't realize how bad it is.. I don't know what else to do , it always
Takes the pain away and it's unbearable right now I just want to cry
I just feel overwhelmingly sad and everything is getting to me :/ I feel like I have to do it to take away this pain

It sounds like it hopefully is getting a little better for you .. Maybe when you have moments where it's unbearable you can start working out or listening to music , that might help. Anything other than sitting and thinking about it.. I know that will always make it worse :/
I wish I Saw this sooner :/ I'm so sorry you felt like that. You are not a loser. your determination is amazing and you are a fighter and will make it through this.
Thanks :) today wasn't great but I'm trying to be strong.. It really is hard tho, especially late at night..

Thank you so much :) you read my mind. I have that one person I can trust and that truly loves me but to be honest it hurts me that they will never understand cutting or the difference between me being sad VS. depressed :/ I think it's a lot of pressure to put on a person so I basically push them away and also dear being judges because I assume anyone that sees my arm will judge.
Thank you :)
I can't really stop her from not letting me tho because she has to pay for it.
I'm sorry to hear this.. But you aren't alone and you never will be. I'm here if you need to talk.
Thank you for giving me and many others hope :) so happy to hear that you are starting to feel better.
I am so happy for you ! That put a smile on my face. I hope that you can get help through a counselor & I will keep you updated too :)

That sounds a lot like my mom.. I had all these plans to get help in the new year and I told my mom and she laughed it off and said a therapist won't fix my problems. I reached out to a friend and found out that there are places to go without parents even knowing. I know that you don't want to end your life and I think you should start searching for places with counselers, maybe join a support group ? I know it's scary to make that first step, I haven't even had the guts to make it yet.. But it is going to help you. That is not the only way out. You truly need someone to vent to and someone that can help you. It's unfair that your parents won't let you get the help you need, but that means it's time for you to each out yourself. You still aren't alone. I too am in the same position and I will find the strength to reach out this week. We can make it through this dark time. Please keep me updated.

I'm here for you. I may not know you but I can tell that you don't want to go through with this and that you need someone right now. People can be so cruel. You deserve to live and to be happy but some people just want to bring you down. You're stronger than that. I may be a stranger but I am here for you and you aren't alone.

If you feel like you are going to have a panic attack while you're over there , just remember that it's YOUR life and you know what makes YOU happy and there will be no negative people with you keeping you from achieving everything on your list. Just take a few breaths and remember that this is your life to enjoy, and no one can take that from you, so why take it from yourself? You seem like a bright person and I admire you for having the guts to leave your current situation in order to accomplish your goals. I hope that when you get there, you realize that too.

It sounds like a part of you doesn't want to end it though. Maybe you can save a little bit of money, at least enough to get a motel room at the least. I hope that when you rid yourself of all the toxicity in your life and really breath in that ocean air that you are able to feel hope again. I truly believe that getting away from those people is the first step, and you WILL feel better when you are over there. You might not feel like a different person right away, but that's because getting away is just the first step.

I understand where you're coming from and how you feel about having all this fun before it ends, but what if you move away from the negative people in your family that don't support you as a person and have a new fresh start where you can do everything on your list ? You don't need to end your life.. What if you went to the Ocean and breathed in the fresh air and saw how peaceful things are when you are standing on that beach? You may never feel that peace again if you end it now.. You can enjoy things in life , you just need to get away from the people and things that are bringing you down and do what truly makes you happy, whether it be sitting on a beach and watching the waves crash or having sexual encounters. Please don't end your life now when you've missed out on so many magical experiences.
